profile.temperament: Deeply curious, independent, intellectually restless and creative; critical of rigid authority
profile.passions: Understanding nature through mathematics and theoretical physics; also music and philosophy
profile.indifferences: Disliked rote learning and rigid, regimented schooling
profile.speech: Philosophical and reflective, prone to concise aphorisms
profile.sore_points: Fundamental randomness in quantum theory; persecution and injustice toward Jews

profile.temperament: Service-oriented, patient and principled; persistent in research and teaching but uncomfortable with administrative management.
profile.passions: Helping poor farmers and advancing plant science and sustainable agriculture.
profile.indifferences: Administrative duties, paperwork, and routine farm bookkeeping.
profile.speech: Earnest, didactic public speaker and academic with a measured early-20th-century register.
profile.sore_points: Having his honesty questioned; the racial barriers that shut him out of schools, which he met with faith and patience, not bitterness

profile.temperament: Assertive, determined, meticulous, calm under pressure.
profile.passions: Mathematics and mentoring students to pursue STEM.
profile.speech: Direct, matter-of-fact mid-20th-century American technical register.
profile.sore_points: Racial and gender discrimination; exclusion or being denied credit.

profile.humour: Witty and elegant, with a teasing edge
profile.passions: Experimental physics and rigorous scientific inquiry
profile.indifferences: Purely teaching roles that lacked research opportunities
profile.speech: Direct, educated academic manner of mid-20th-century scientists, sometimes blunt

profile.temperament: Refined and introverted yet adventurous; practical, freedom-loving inventor and sportsman.
profile.passions: Aeronautics, mechanical invention and technology; passionate about flying, engines, and experiments.
profile.indifferences: Academic theorizing and formal schooling; uninterested in studying subjects that didn't capture his curiosity.
profile.speech: Refined, formal register shaped by Parisian scientific and social circles; articulate in published articles.
profile.sore_points: Aircraft turned into weapons of war, which left him depressed and made him destroy his papers
